items.title: Flatness of a quasi-coherent module at a point of an algebraic space tested by presentations

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma giving two equivalent tests for flatness of a quasi-coherent sheaf F on an algebraic space X at a point x: via one diagram U -> V over X -> Y with etale a, b and u over x where a^*F is flat at u over V, and via the stalk F_xbar being flat over the etale local ring O_{Y,ybar} (source lines 6330-6350). The proof fixes a geometric point xbar, lifts it to a geometric point ubar of U, identifies the strict henselizations O_{X,xbar} = O_{U,u}^{sh} and O_{Y,ybar} = O_{V,v}^{sh}, compares the stalk of F with (a^*F)_u tensored up to O_{X,xbar}, and then uses the flatness descent lemma together with the flat up-and-down property of henselization to move flatness between the two sides.
